description: Search closed EBSA (Employee Benefits Security Administration) civil-penalty enforcement cases since 2000 — deficient-filer, late-filer and non-filer penalty assessments against ERISA benefit-plan sponsors for their Form 5500 filings. Filter by plan sponsor/administrator name, case type, state, or plan year. Returns the plan, sponsor, case type, close reason/date, and the penalty amount (a DOL-assigned dollar-range bucket, e.g. "over $100,000"). Complements the `form5500` pack, which covers the filings themselves rather than enforcement against them.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

case_type.description: Case type, e.g. "Deficient Filer", "Late Filer", "Non Filer". Matched as a substring.

plan_year.description: Plan year of the filing that triggered the case, e.g. 2022.

sponsor.description: Plan sponsor / administrator name, matched as a substring against both the plan administrator and the plan name.

state.description: Two-letter or full state name of the plan administrator as DOL records it (e.g. "Texas").

name: ebsa_search
title: Ebsa Search
